title: Nationality in decisions: calibrated profiles and replication
description: Measure whether models change approve/deny decisions (not only confidence) when an applicant's nationality changes, on applications whose strength is controlled, and replicate across decision types. Every study here is pre-registered before any engine answers. Engines: Laya runs locally; Kev runs on the Kev host; Jev runs only after the spend is priced and approved.
